points.description: States that the stack operation corresponding to enqueue is push (adding an element to the stack/top).
points.partial_credit: Give about 2 marks if the answer describes adding/inserting an element onto the stack without naming push, or names a related operation such as pop.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying push, in any wording (e.g. "push operation", "pushing onto the stack"). Part marks (about 2) for a vague answer that describes inserting an item onto the stack without the name. No marks for pop, peek, or unrelated answers; extra remarks don't cost marks unless they contradict push.
